title: Strata Grid: lightweight GPU capacity cockpit and rapid-burst composer
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design a lightweight, operator-focused cockpit (Strata Grid) for Dedicated GPU capacity that surfaces pool health, predicted cost delta from burst operations, and a rapid 'burst composer' to create on-demand short-lived capacity with safe defaults. This ticket covers low-fidelity through interactive prototype, handoff-ready specs, and an accessibility pass. Goal: enable SREs and platform owners to diagnose urgent capacity pressure and apply a guarded burst within 3 clicks while understanding cost trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Low-fidelity flows for pool diagnosis, thermal/latency lanes, and burst composer reviewed by Eng & PM
Interactive Figma prototype demonstrates 3-click burst with confirmation and cost preview
Design specs include token-level cost callouts, fallback model hints, and autoscale hysteresis affordances
Component library tokens and responsive variants documented for Console dev handoff
Accessibility contrast, keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels documented
comments: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Khan: Kicked off scoping. Working assumptions: operators need fast triage, a cost-aware burst option, and a clear recovery path. Will sketch both single-pool and multi-pool views.

2025-02-14 - Marco Ruiz: Met with ENG to understand runtime constraints. Important trade-off: we cannot trigger cross-region bursts in V1. Backend will expose 'estimated token-cost-per-minute' and 'slo-breach-probability' metrics. Adding these to the UI mockups.
2025-02-16 - PM review (Lena Park): Request to show recent rollback history and links to rollout rules. Also flagged need for 'dry-run' preview for burst cost before apply.

2025-02-18 - Design critique: Reduce visual density for the grid tiles; introduce lane-based telemetry (thermal, tail-latency, backlog) + one-line remediation CTA. Add microcopy explaining autoscale hysteresis to reduce operator confusion.

2025-02-20 - Engineering sync (ENG-3310 owner - Ravi Patel): Confirmed API for burst request requires capacity profile, duration, and safety_policy_id. Will add 'safe defaults' option in composer UI that maps to safety_policy_id 'conservative'.

2025-02-23 - Proto updated: interactive composer includes cost preview, estimated SLO delta, and suggested rollback time. Shared Figma link in attachments. Asking for UX writing pass for confirmation modal.
2025-02-25 - Accessibility check: color ramps adjusted for 4.5:1 contrast. Keyboard stepper for burst size added. Pending screen reader labels.
2025-02-26 - Marco Ruiz: Preparing dev-ready spec and component tokens. Handoff meeting scheduled 2025-02-28 with ENG and PM. Marking as In Progress until handoff completes.
notes: Design decisions and trade-offs: prioritise a compact 'tile' view for ops that fits into single screen; allow expansion to detailed timeline for incident post-mortems.
We decided against embedding full cost-calc in the tile to keep real-time telemetry snappy; instead show delta estimate and link to cost-breakdown panel for deep inspection.
Burst safety defaults: conservative (short duration, capped GPUs), standard (balanced), aggressive (longer duration, higher cost). Each maps to predefined server-side policies.
Consider a future enhancement: an autoscale policy simulator that runs hypothetical traffic profiles to show cost vs latency curves (out of scope for V1).
